2) Net terms: request to move the renewal invoice to Net60 for this committed capacity.

To keep the timeline tight (targeting activation of extra capacity on 1 Jun), can you confirm the following by EOD Monday:
- Which legal names and remit addresses we should use for each invoice line (legal entity + EIN/VAT).
- PO number(s) to reference on the invoices.
- Billing contact(s) for remittance and AP email addresses.

I've attached a draft amendment that shows the capacity increase and an invoice split example — we can update the payor lines once you confirm the exact legal entities/POs. Also attaching our W9 for your AP team.

Next steps from our side once we have the PO + billing contacts:
- Finance will issue two invoices (one per entity) referencing the PO(s).
- We'll route the DocuSign amendment for signature reflecting Net60 on the renewal invoice.
- If EU needs VAT documentation, please share the VAT ID and billing address.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
